description: Golden reference for metatrain PET model 'pet-attn2', case 'molecule'. Energy in eV, positions in Angstrom, forces in eV/Angstrom. Total energy INCLUDES composition energies and the output scaler.
evaluation_path: metatrain.utils.io.load_model(ckpt).export() -> metatomic AtomisticModel; MetatomicCalculator(model, variants={'energy': 'None'}).compute_energy(atoms, compute_forces_and_stresses=True, per_atom=True)
notes: SYNTHETIC model: pet-mad-xs v1.6.0 with num_attention_layers raised to 2 and block 0 copied into block 1 with a 5% per-tensor perturbation (tools/make_multilayer_checkpoint.py pet-mad-xs out.ckpt --version 1.6.0 --layers 2 --distinct 0.05). The blocks differ, so an implementation that read block 0's weights for every block fails this. Reference from metatrain itself, as for every golden.
